_comment: Cards that exist only for the card-in-exile target test (tests/unit/test_card_in_exile_target.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_magicite` is the Espers to Magicite shape: exile every opponent's graveyard, then target one of the cards THIS spell put there. `t_wide_magicite` is the counterfactual -- the same target line without the binding, which reaches every creature card anyone has ever exiled.

cards.name: Test Magicite
cards.oracle_text: Exile each opponent's graveyard. When you do, choose up to one target creature card exiled this way. Put it onto the battlefield under your control.

abilities.text: When you do, choose up to one target creature card exiled this way.

cards.name: Test Wide Magicite
cards.oracle_text: Exile each opponent's graveyard. When you do, choose up to one target creature card in exile. Put it onto the battlefield under your control.

abilities.text: When you do, choose up to one target creature card in exile.
